description: The KRYNORCXY Desktop PC is designed for users seeking a balanced combination of processing performance, everyday productivity and an attractive modern workstation setup. Powered by a Core i7 4770 processor and equipped with 16GB RAM, the system provides responsive performance for office applications, web browsing, online learning, multimedia, document management and everyday computing requirements. The integrated HD Graphics 4600 delivers dependable graphics performance for everyday display output and general multimedia usage. The system includes SSD storage for faster system responsiveness, application loading and file access compared with conventional hard-drive-based configurations. The complete setup features a 22-inch frameless white LED monitor, complemented by a 4-fan RGB white cabinet and RGB white keyboard and mouse for a coordinated desktop appearance. Connectivity options include HDMI, VGA, Ethernet and WiFi, providing flexibility for different display and network requirements. Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro, the computer is ready for setup and everyday use.
